title: Cardinality of successive étale contraction
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $\kappa$ an infinite cardinal in its universe with $|R|\leq\kappa$. Let $R^{\mathrm e}$ be the successive étale contraction of [def-weil-pbc-etale-contraction], using one skeletal representative of each faithfully flat étale algebra at each step. Then $|R^{\mathrm e}|\leq\kappa$.

source.place: Tag 097S (remark-size-T): the finite-tensor filtered-colimit step and its countable iteration; finite polynomial-presentation expansion for the chosen-skeleton implementation.

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra], a finitely presented R-algebra is isomorphic to R[x₁,...,xₙ]/(s) for a finite set s of polynomials. MvPolynomial.cardinalMk_le_max_lift bounds each polynomial ring by κ, since n is finite. The finite-list estimate [lem-weil-pbc-finite-list-cardinality] bounds finite sets of such polynomials, and the countable disjoint union over n also has size at most κ.

In [def-weil-pbc-etale-contraction], choose a finite presentation of the algebra associated to each skeletal representative. The algebra structure is its actual structural ring map. If two presentation codes agree, compose the two algebra equivalences to obtain an isomorphism of algebras over R. Opposite ring equivalences give an isomorphism in the full morphism-property over category, since algebra equivalences commute with R. Pull it back along the fully faithful composite from Skeleton(SmallModel C) to C. Skeletality makes the two representatives equal. This proves that the chosen code map is injective and bounds the representative type by κ.

FiniteFamilies of representatives injects into Finset of representatives by U ↦ U.finite.toFinset, so the finite-diagram index has size at most κ. For each object U of the finite diagram, the structural map is the base map of a finite wide pullback of étale maps in CommRingCat opposite. The existing proved library lemma MorphismProperty.widePullbackBase applies to etale.op and the properties of the represented maps; hence the unop structural map is étale. It is therefore of finite presentation and finite type. A surjection from a polynomial ring in finitely many variables bounds this stage by κ. For empty U the map is the identity of R and the same argument applies.

The finite-family poset is directed and inhabited by the empty family. Over.forget preserves these connected limits. Unop the image of the limit cone of finiteDiagram to obtain a colimit of commutative rings. Concrete.from_union_surjective_of_isColimit, the representative clause of [lem-pc-filtered-colimit-commrings-elementwise], gives a surjection from the disjoint union of its stages. The index and fiber bounds of the previous steps prove |step(R)| ≤ κ. Induction gives the same bound for every stage R_n of [def-weil-pbc-etale-contraction]. The sequence is indexed by the directed set of natural numbers. Unop its limit cone, apply the same representative theorem, and count the pairs (n,a), with n natural and a in R_n, to conclude |Rᵉ| ≤ κ.

mathlib_searches.query: The skeleton of finitely presented etale algebras over a ring R has cardinality bounded by max aleph0 cardinal R
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits: FGAlgCatSkeleton and its n and eval, Algebra.FiniteType.exists_fgAlgCatSkeleton, Algebra.Etale.finitePresentation, Algebra.Etale.exists_subalgebra_fg, and finite-presentation generator/relation data. FGAlgCatSkeleton allows arbitrary ideals, so it gives essential smallness but not the required sharp cardinal bound; the proof uses finite relation sets instead.
